Answer: C
Reason: Visual inspection of Figure 1a reveals a massive opacity occupying the right hemithorax that obscures the right heart border and diaphragm, consistent with a large posterior mediastinal mass compressing the right lung; the trachea remains midline and the cardiac silhouette is not significantly displaced to the left, ruling out options A and D. The lateral view (Figure 1b) confirms a large retrocardiac/posterior density, supporting the posterior location described in option C over anterior or homogeneous descriptions.
